tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250snang srid zhi ba dkar po'i mgron lnga'i gshegs gsol sogs ni/ 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba khyad par 'phags pa'i tshogs// rab 'byams kun khyab mtha' dang mnyam pa 'di// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mgron rnams la// gus pas 'bul bzhes phrin las kun 'grub mdzod// de rnams mchod pa'i mgron rnams rang rang gi /gnas su gshegs te slar yang 'gro don du// spyan 'dren dus su dbyings nas skur bzhengs te// 'byon cing phrin las sna tshogs yongs 'grub mdzod// mgron tshan lnga po mchod cing bsnyen bkur mthus// tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi// mthun rkyen tshe bsod dge legs rab 'phel nas// phyi ma gtan bde bla med thob par shog /stobs bcu mnga' ba kun dang des gsung chos// nyan rang byang sems lha tshogs ma lus kyi// bden stobs nus pas bkra shis dge legs ni// yar ngo'i zla ltar gong nas gong 'phel shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa yis// bkra shis dge legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar gong nas gong 'phel shog /chos sku longs sku sprul sku rdo rje gsum// rten 'brel rgyu rkyen bslu med bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar bsam pa'i don ltar 'grub pa yi// bkra shis dge legs nyi zla ltar gsal ba// nub med bstan 'gro'i mkha' la rtag 'char ba// myur ba nyid du 'grub pa nyid gyur cig /
ces dang bkra shis gzhan yang bya'o// zhes pa dge slong karma mgon pos bskul ba ltar rol pa rdo rjes bris/
